title: NRCH no persistent division replicates on seed 4: 6 splits, 2 persistent, generation 2, merges = splits; swimmers still travel 10.8 BL
summary: Fresh seed 4 of the finding's world.py at its defaults (Dt=-0.2, no reaction or AMB+ terms), 192^2, t=6000. labkit: 6 splits, 2 persistent, max generation 2, 6 merges (merge/split 1.0), 0 failures from sibling re-merging; 9 tracks >= 1 BL, max 10.8 BL. The lineage (rerun/lineage.png) shows most daughters ending within ~500-1500 t by fusion. My two earlier NRCH reviews on seed 3 agree: plain NRCH (Dt=-0.3) 8 splits, 0 persistent; NRCH with AMB+ and reaction 44 splits, 0 persistent (20261025T1049-c01-review-nrch, 20261025T1101-c01-review-nrch-flock).

observations.F: rerun/FACTS.md: 2 of 6 splits persistent, generation 2, merges 6; rerun/lineage.png

controls_run.F: the finding's own arms; my seed-3 runs in 20261025T1101-c01-review-nrch-flock (plain/ and both/)

verdicts.limitation: One default arm on a new seed; the noise and reaction arms are the author's.
